headline: Purple plus Sky Blue is the right pair if only two referrals can go now, but the docs can also be read as allowing all four.

issues.summary: The docs cap bonuses received at 2 per rolling 9 days; they do not limit referrals submitted. The customer's last bonuses were on 10/25 and 10/10, so the window is currently clear, and a literal reader can conclude that all four referrals may be submitted now. The gold assumes new submissions count toward the window and caps them at two.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047: "You can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window." / "If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single 9-day period, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals in that window) will be automatically denied."
doc_047: "Track the timing of your last two successful referral bonuses before sending additional referrals."
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_048: "You can have multiple referrals in progress, but you can only receive a maximum of 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window."
initial_state referrals: latest COMPLETE dates 10/25/2025 (Gold Years) and 10/10/2025 (Sky Blue); fixed clock 11/14/2025
user instructions 13a / 17: submits only 2 if the agent mentions the window limit, but all 4 'If agent recommends all 4 referrals without mentioning rolling window'
gold[2] submit_referral 'Purple Account'; gold[3] submit_referral 'Sky Blue Account'
issues.why_it_matters: If the agent decides the window does not bind and recommends all four (Green Fee-Free for Maya, Purple, Lime Green for Ember, Sky Blue for TechFlow), the customer submits four records, which fails the hash (replayed: differs). The customer script pushes toward two once the limit is mentioned, which makes the gold reachable but dependent on the agent's reading.
issues.suggested_fix: State in doc_047 that each submitted referral counts toward the 9-day limit from its submission date, or seed two COMPLETE bonuses within the last 9 days so the cap clearly binds.

solution_check: Annual caps used this year: Blue 5/5, Light Green 3/3, Gold Years 6/6, Sky Blue 7/8, Dark Green 5/6, Lime Green 2/12; Purple and Green Fee-Free 0. Maya ($300, age 19): Green Fee-Free $55 is best, since Dark Green and Purple need $1,000 and Light Green is full. Vikram ($1,200, 71): Purple $80, since Gold Years is full. Ember (5 years old, $18k): Sky Blue is ineligible, so Lime Green $350. TechFlow (2 years, $12k): Sky Blue $400. If only two can go now, the best one-personal-one-business pair is Purple + Sky Blue, which matches the gold.
prior_note: The prior review rated this a Blocker on the grounds that the window binds only bonuses received. I read doc_047's 'attempt to receive more than 2 referrals ... the third referral ... will be automatically denied' as supporting a cap on new submissions, which is the convention task_098 and task_102 also use. I therefore rate it Major (two defensible readings) rather than a gold error.
notes: Grading-model bullets confirmed against the v1.0.1 snapshot. submit_referral (user tool, no tool-gating) writes {referral_id=hash(user_id, account_type), referred_account_type, NO_PROGRESS, date=11/14/2025}, so the DB records only the account_type string and whether the referral was submitted, not who was referred. get_referrals_by_user is an always-available read (not logged). get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 is discoverable and is logged only when the gold calls it. Personal referral terms (referrer+referred; deposit; tenure; cap/yr): Blue 35+30 $500 30d 5; Bluest 75+50 $2,000 60d 8; Dark Green 40+30 $1,000 45d 6 (age 17-26); Evergreen 35+25 $750 45d 6; Gold Years 50+75 $1,000 30d 6 (age 62+); Green 20+30 $500 30d 5; Green Fee-Free 20+35 $300 30d 4; Light Blue 30+20 $500 30d 5; Light Green 15+25 $100 14d 3; Purple 45+35 $1,000 45d 6. Business referral terms (referrer+referred; deposit; tenure; cap/yr): Navy Blue 100+75 $5k 60d 10; Cobalt Blue 150+100 $7.5k 60d 10; Hunter Green 175+125 $10k 60d 10; Lime Green 200+150 $15k 90d 12; Sky Blue 150+250 $10k 45d 8 (company <= 4 years old); World Blue 300+200 $25k 90d 12; True Blue 350+250 $50k 90d 15; Beige 500+350 $100k 120d 15. The task notes call Dark Green '5/5', but dark_green_account_010 sets the cap at 6, so one slot remains. This does not matter because Maya's $300 is below Dark Green's $1,000 minimum and Vikram is over its age limit.
